scene: You step from the dragon train into the glowing, bustling night market.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view of a stone market platform. On the far left sits the sleek, open-doored maglev dragon train. Left of centre stands the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt, top knot, sandals, holding a ukulele. To his left stands a brass tea-pouring robot; to his right, giant dumpling steamers and a red moon gate.
shown: a mechanical brass tea-pouring robot standing behind a steaming cart on the left
a towering wooden stack of bamboo dumpling steamers puffing steam on the right
a circular red moon gate glowing beneath an archway on the far right
